# orca command

Every `orca command` command. Ids: a full id, a unique prefix, or (projects) a name or path.

## `orca command show <commandId> [--group <group>] [--operator] [--spend] [--corrections] [--orchestration]`

a command's retained result, looked up under its scope

- What it does: reads from the panel (no write).
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `<commandId>`: the id the CLI printed (cli-<uuid>)
- `--group <group>`: a group's command
- `--operator`: an operator setting's command
- `--spend`: a spend command
- `--corrections`: a correction command
- `--orchestration`: an orchestration command

```
orca command show cli-0f1e… --group g1
orca command show cli-0f1e… --spend
```

## `orca command retry --request <request>`

for an uncertain outcome: look the request up first; resend its exact bytes only on a confirmed miss

- What it does: runs locally.
- Who may: open over the socket (a flag marked human-only still needs a person token).
- `--request <request>` (required): the --json envelope's request, as a file or - for stdin

```
orca group start g1 --json > out.json; jq .request out.json > req.json; orca command retry --request req.json
```
